This plot is not my main maize field — it is a small rented piece where I grow other crops, intercropped to make the most of the land. Since I do not own it, I will not spend scarce money on chemical fertilizer or hybrid seed for this one; I will save those inputs for my main field if I get any FISP coupon. I will put some household manure on it and use seed I saved from last year. My children and I will do the weeding and harvesting ourselves — I cannot afford ganyu labor for such a small plot.
